title: Kling v3 Omni
summary: Generate image with Kling v3 Omni
description: Kling AI v3 Omni — unified text-to-image and image editing with multi-reference composition from up to 9 reference images and up to 4K output. Billing: 35 credits per image at 1K/2K, 60 at 4K.

prompt.description: Text description of the image to generate.

reference_images.description: Optional reference images (up to 9) for image editing and multi-reference composition. Each item is a public image URL, a data URI, raw base64, or an uploaded-file URL from POST /v1/uploads. Omit for text-to-image.

size.description: Output resolution tier. 1K/2K bill 35 credits per image; 4K bills 60.
